selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of progressive dysarthria, dysphagia, cognitive impairment, vertical gaze palsy, tongue atrophy, and pyramidal signs, combined with the genetic testing showing a heterozygous pathogenic variant of the TBK1 gene, supports FTLD-MND. The severe loss of dopamine transporter binding in basal ganglia and almost total loss in caudate nucleus also aligns with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence supporting this diagnosis in the vignette

rejected.label: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
rejected.why: While some motor neuron disease features are present, the combination of cognitive impairment, vertical gaze palsy, and specific genetic findings points more strongly towards FTLD-MND
